blurb: Wood Mountain Regional Park is located 8km south of the town of Wood Mountain in Saskatchewan. WMRP is best known for its unique rolling hills location. Perfect site for family gatherings, offering spacious campsites and family activities. Home of Camp Woodboia, who offers youth a fun summertime activity. It’s also the site of Canada’s oldest continuous Rodeo.
